recipes.title: Track demo: night phonk
recipes.intent: A 2:29 night phonk track: deep lead and counter-melody, hazy pad, 808 with glide and ducking, trap drums with rolls, cowbell, risers and impacts, vox textures, glue bus.
recipes.code:
// Night phonk demo: G minor, VI-i-VII-VI, half-time feel on a 128.8 bpm grid, 80 bars = 2:29
// intro 1-8 | build 9-16 | drop 17-32 | breakdown 33-40 | build 2 41-48 | drop 2 49-72 | outro 73-80
setcpm(128.8 / 4)
await voxBank('ljspeech'); await voxBank('sung'); await voxBank('call-me-baby'); await voxBank('vocalset')

// == glyphcore/phonk: atoms (harmony, lines, rhythms, gates) ==
atom("ph.chords", { type: "mini", body: "<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [g3,bb3,d4,f4] [f3,a3,c4,eb4] [eb3,g3,bb3,d4]>" })
atom("ph.sub", { type: "mini", body: "<[eb1@7 eb1@3 eb1@6] [f1@7 g1@3 g1@6] [f1@7 f1@3 f1@6] [eb1@7 eb1@3 bb0@6]>" })
atom("ph.glide", { type: "mini", body: "<0 [0 -2 0] 0 [0 0 5]>" })
atom("ph.lead", { type: "mini", body: "<[~@4 g4@4 bb4@3 d5@2 a4@3] [a4@8 ~@4 bb4 c5@2 a4] [g4@6 ~@2 f4@2 g4@2 bb4@4] [bb4@6 a4@4 g4@6]>" })
atom("ph.counter", { type: "mini", body: "<[d4@8 c4@4 bb3@4] [~@10 f4@2 eb4@2 d4@2] [c4@8 bb3@4 a3@4] [~@8 g3@8]>" })
atom("ph.bell", { type: "mini", body: "<[g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ ~ bb5 ~ g5 ~ ~ d5 ~ f5 ~ ~] [g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ ~ a5 ~ f5 ~ ~ d5 ~ eb5 ~ ~]>" })
atom("ph.kick", { type: "mini", body: "<[x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]!3 [x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x x]>" })
atom("ph.snare", { type: "mini", body: "~ ~ x ~" })
atom("ph.ghost", { type: "mini", body: "~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ x" })
atom("ph.hats", { type: "mini", body: "<x*16!3 [x x x x x x x x [x x x]*4 x x x x]>" })
atom("ph.accent", { type: "mini", body: "[1 .45 .7 .45]*4" })
atom("ph.roll", { type: "mini", body: "x*16" })
atom("ph.every4", { type: "mini", body: "<x ~ ~ ~>/4" })
atom("ph.lastBar", { type: "mini", body: "<~ ~ ~ x>" })
atom("ph.noDrums", { type: "gate", body: "<9b, 33b..41b, 77b.." })
atom("ph.noLow", { type: "gate", body: "<17b, 33b..49b, 75b.." })
atom("ph.noDrop", { type: "gate", body: "<17b, 33b..49b, 73b.." })
atom("ph.noRoll", { type: "gate", body: "<15b, 17b..47b, 49b.." })
atom("ph.noRise", { type: "gate", body: "<13b, 17b..45b, 49b.." })
atom("ph.dark", { type: "gate", body: "<9b, 33b..41b, 73b.." })
atom("ph.builds", { type: "gate", body: "9b..17b, 41b..49b" })
atom("ph.drop2", { type: "gate", body: "49b..73b" })

// == glyphcore/phonk: racks (instrument rigs as hook defs) ==
hooks.def("kick808", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-kick"], ["s", "sine"], ["freq", 55], ["penv", 36], ["pdecay", 0.04], ["decay", 0.28], ["sustain", 0], ["noise", 0.12], ["shape", 0.4], ["gain", 0.8]] })
hooks.def("snareNoise", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-snare"], ["s", "triangle"], ["note", "d3"], ["noise", 0.85], ["decay", 0.19], ["sustain", 0], ["hpf", 170], ["gain", 0.9]] })
hooks.def("hat", { params: { len: { min: 0.01, max: 0.2, default: 0.05 } }, chain: [["hook", "hygiene-hat"], ["s", "white"], ["hpf", 7000], ["decay", { $param: "len" }], ["sustain", 0], ["gain", 0.45]] })
hooks.def("cowbell", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-bell"], ["s", "square"], ["bpf", 1300], ["bpq", 2.5], ["decay", 0.17], ["sustain", 0], ["gain", 0.28]] })
hooks.def("sub808", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-sub"], ["s", "sine"], ["attack", 0.004], ["pdecay", 0.14], ["decay", 0.6], ["sustain", 0.7], ["release", 0.1], ["shape", 0.45], ["lpf", 600], ["gain", 0.45], ["postgain", 0.87]] })
hooks.def("hazePad", { params: { cut: { min: 200, max: 5000, default: 1400 } }, chain: [["hook", "hygiene-pad"], ["s", "supersaw"], ["unison", 4], ["detune", 0.22], ["attack", 0.8], ["sustain", 0.8], ["release", 2.5], ["lpf", { $param: "cut" }], ["lpenv", 1.5], ["lpattack", 1.6], ["gain", 0.2]] })
hooks.def("deepLead", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-lead"], ["s", "sawtooth"], ["lpf", 1900], ["lpenv", 1], ["lpdecay", 0.25], ["attack", 0.012], ["sustain", 0.6], ["release", 0.35], ["vib", 5], ["vibmod", 0.1], ["gain", 0.38]] })
hooks.def("wideLead", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-lead"], ["s", { $mini: "sawtooth, square" }], ["lpf", 2600], ["lpenv", 1], ["attack", 0.012], ["sustain", 0.6], ["release", 0.4], ["vib", 5], ["vibmod", 0.1], ["gain", 0.27]] })
hooks.def("echoPluck", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-pluck"], ["s", "triangle"], ["decay", 0.25], ["sustain", 0.2], ["release", 0.3], ["delay", 0.35], ["delaytime", 0.349], ["delayfeedback", 0.45], ["gain", 0.4]] })
hooks.def("formant", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-vox"], ["attack", 0.6], ["release", 1.5], ["vowel", "o"], ["lpf", 2400], ["gain", 0.36]] })
hooks.def("chop", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-vox"], ["end", 0.3], ["hpf", 300], ["lpf", 3500], ["gain", 0.32]] })
hooks.def("riser", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-riser"], ["s", "white"], ["attack", 6], ["release", 0.3], ["hpf", 300], ["lpf", 900], ["lpenv", 3.5], ["lpattack", 7], ["gain", 0.3]] })
hooks.def("reverseHit", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-reverse"], ["s", "white"], ["attack", 1.7], ["sustain", 1], ["release", 0.02], ["hpf", 2500], ["gain", 0.3]] })
hooks.def("impact", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-impact"], ["s", "sine"], ["note", "c1"], ["penv", 30], ["pdecay", 0.2], ["decay", 2.5], ["sustain", 0], ["noise", 0.25], ["gain", 0.7]] })
hooks.def("tape", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-texture"], ["hpf", 3500], ["gain", 0.05]] })
// shared moves: filter state, drive, duck to the kick
hooks.def("murk", { chain: [["lpf", { $mini: "<500 600 750 900 750 600>" }]] })
hooks.def("thin", { params: { hz: { min: 100, max: 2000, default: 450 } }, chain: [["hpf", { $param: "hz" }]] })
hooks.def("grit", { params: { amt: { min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 } }, chain: [["shape", { $param: "amt" }]] })
hooks.def("pump", { params: { depth: { min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.6 } }, chain: [["wire", "gain", "kick:env", { range: [1, { $expr: "1-depth" }], op: "mul", r: 0.18 }]] })

// == track: racks into slots, gated moves ==
hooks.bind("kick", "kick808"); hooks.bind("snare", "snareNoise"); hooks.bind("hat", "hat"); hooks.bind("bell", "cowbell")
hooks.bind("sub", "sub808"); hooks.bind("pad", "hazePad"); hooks.bind("ctr", "echoPluck"); hooks.bind("rise", "riser")
hooks.bind("rev", "reverseHit"); hooks.bind("hit", "impact"); hooks.bind("vox", "chop"); hooks.bind("voxpad", "formant"); hooks.bind("tex", "tape")
hooks.slot("lead", { mode: "swap" }); hooks.bind("lead", "deepLead"); hooks.bind("lead", "wideLead", atoms.ph.drop2, { priority: 1 })
hooks.bind("tone", "murk", atoms.ph.dark); hooks.bind("tone", "thin", atoms.ph.builds); hooks.bind("drive", "grit(0.55)", atoms.ph.drop2); hooks.bind("duck", "pump")

// == macros ==
ctl("macro", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 1 }); ctl("space", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 })
ctl("grit", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 }); ctl("energy", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 })
hooks.map("macro", "lpf", { range: [0.1, 1], curve: "exp", op: "mul" }); hooks.map("space", "room", { range: [0, 2], op: "mul" })
hooks.map("grit", "shape", { range: [0, 2], op: "mul" }); hooks.map("energy", "velocity", { range: [0.6, 1.4], op: "mul" })

// == lanes ==
kick: s(atoms.ph.kick).use("kick").velocity(1).tap("kick", { export: true }).tags("drums", "low")
snare: s(atoms.ph.snare).use("snare").velocity(1).room(0.25).tags("drums")
ghost: s(atoms.ph.ghost).use("snare").velocity(0.22).tags("drums")
roll: s(atoms.ph.roll).use("snare").velocity(saw.range(0.25, 1).slow(2)).tags("drums", "roll")
hats: s(atoms.ph.hats).use("hat").velocity(atoms.ph.accent).nudge(rand.range(0, 0.006)).swingBy(0.06, 8).use("duck").tags("drums")
bell: note(atoms.ph.bell).add(note("0,6.8")).use("bell").use("duck").velocity(1).room(0.3).tags("bell", "wet")
sub: note(atoms.ph.sub).penv(atoms.ph.glide).use("sub").postgain(1).use("drive").orbit(3).tags("low")
pad: note(atoms.ph.chords).use("pad").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(900, 1800)).use("tone").pan(0.5).orbit(4).tags("harm", "wet")
lead: note(atoms.ph.lead).use("lead").use("tone").use("drive").room(0.3).tags("melody", "wet")
ctr: note(atoms.ph.counter).use("ctr").use("tone").use("duck").orbit(6).tags("melody", "counter", "wet")
voxpad: s("<vs_o_pp vs_a_pp>/2").note("<g4 d4>/2").use("voxpad").orbit(4).tags("vox", "wet")
chop: word("<ay ee>").struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ x").use("vox").use("duck").tags("vox", "wet", "chop")
swell: stack(word("air").struct(atoms.ph.lastBar).attack(0.45).release(0.05).speed(0.8).hpf(500).gain(0.3),
  word("breath").note("d#4").struct("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ x]>").gain(0.25)).tags("vox", "fx", "wet") // one lane for both: as two lanes they raise AudioNode errors on the site (#92)
rise: s(atoms.ph.every4).use("rise").tags("fx", "rise")
rev: s(atoms.ph.lastBar).use("rev").tags("fx", "rise")
hit: s(atoms.ph.every4).slow(4).use("hit").room(0.4).tags("fx", "hit")
tex: s("pink, brown").use("tex").tags("tex")
crackle: s("white*8").degradeBy(0.6).attack(0.002).decay(0.015).sustain(0).hpf(2500).gain(rand.range(0.02, 0.07)).tags("tex")
verb: ret("verb").room(1).rsize(5).hpf(200).lpf(5000).orbit(8)
glue: ret("glue").compressor("-24:4:6:.01:.15").gain(0.5).orbit(9)

// == arrangement and mix: selections, not copies ==
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.ph.noDrums); tagged("low").mute(atoms.ph.noLow); tagged("bell | counter | chop").mute(atoms.ph.noDrop)
tagged("roll").mute(atoms.ph.noRoll); tagged("rise").mute(atoms.ph.noRise); tagged("hit").mute("<17b, 18b..49b, 50b..")
tagged("wet").send("verb", 0.35); tagged("low").send("glue", 0.35)

recipes.title: Track demo: night phonk v2

// intro 1-8 | build 9-16 | drop A (confrontation) 17-32 | relief 1 33-40 | stop > drop B 41-52 | relief 2 53-60 | build 61-64 | drop C 65-80 | outro 81-84
setcpm(128.8 / 4)
await voxBank('ljspeech'); await voxBank('sung'); await voxBank('call-me-baby'); await voxBank('vocalset')

// == glyphcore/phonk: atoms (v1 items, unchanged) ==
atom("ph.chords", { type: "mini", body: "<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [g3,bb3,d4,f4] [f3,a3,c4,eb4] [eb3,g3,bb3,d4]>" })

atom("ph.kick", { type: "mini", body: "<[x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]!3 [x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x x]>" })
atom("ph.snare", { type: "mini", body: "~ ~ x ~" })
atom("ph.ghost", { type: "mini", body: "~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ x" })
atom("ph.hats", { type: "mini", body: "<x*16!3 [x x x x x x x x [x x x]*4 x x x x]>" })
atom("ph.accent", { type: "mini", body: "[1 .45 .7 .45]*4" })
atom("ph.roll", { type: "mini", body: "x*16" })
atom("ph.lastBar", { type: "mini", body: "<~ ~ ~ x>" })

// == glyphcore/phonk: racks (v1 items, unchanged) ==
hooks.def("kick808", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-kick"], ["s", "sine"], ["freq", 55], ["penv", 36], ["pdecay", 0.04], ["decay", 0.28], ["sustain", 0], ["noise", 0.12], ["shape", 0.4], ["gain", 0.8]] })
hooks.def("snareNoise", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-snare"], ["s", "triangle"], ["note", "d3"], ["noise", 0.85], ["decay", 0.19], ["sustain", 0], ["hpf", 170], ["gain", 0.9]] })
hooks.def("hat", { params: { len: { min: 0.01, max: 0.2, default: 0.05 } }, chain: [["hook", "hygiene-hat"], ["s", "white"], ["hpf", 7000], ["decay", { $param: "len" }], ["sustain", 0], ["gain", 0.45]] })
hooks.def("cowbell", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-bell"], ["s", "square"], ["bpf", 1300], ["bpq", 2.5], ["decay", 0.17], ["sustain", 0], ["gain", 0.28]] })
hooks.def("sub808", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-sub"], ["s", "sine"], ["attack", 0.004], ["pdecay", 0.14], ["decay", 0.6], ["sustain", 0.7], ["release", 0.1], ["shape", 0.45], ["lpf", 600], ["gain", 0.45], ["postgain", 0.87]] })
hooks.def("hazePad", { params: { cut: { min: 200, max: 5000, default: 1400 } }, chain: [["hook", "hygiene-pad"], ["s", "supersaw"], ["unison", 4], ["detune", 0.22], ["attack", 0.8], ["sustain", 0.8], ["release", 2.5], ["lpf", { $param: "cut" }], ["lpenv", 1.5], ["lpattack", 1.6], ["gain", 0.2]] })
hooks.def("deepLead", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-lead"], ["s", "sawtooth"], ["lpf", 1900], ["lpenv", 1], ["lpdecay", 0.25], ["attack", 0.012], ["sustain", 0.6], ["release", 0.35], ["vib", 5], ["vibmod", 0.1], ["gain", 0.38]] })

hooks.def("formant", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-vox"], ["attack", 0.6], ["release", 1.5], ["vowel", "o"], ["lpf", 2400], ["gain", 0.36]] })
hooks.def("chop", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-vox"], ["end", 0.3], ["hpf", 300], ["lpf", 3500], ["gain", 0.32]] })
hooks.def("riser", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-riser"], ["s", "white"], ["attack", 6], ["release", 0.3], ["hpf", 300], ["lpf", 900], ["lpenv", 3.5], ["lpattack", 7], ["gain", 0.3]] })
hooks.def("reverseHit", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-reverse"], ["s", "white"], ["attack", 1.7], ["sustain", 1], ["release", 0.02], ["hpf", 2500], ["gain", 0.3]] })
hooks.def("impact", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-impact"], ["s", "sine"], ["note", "c1"], ["penv", 30], ["pdecay", 0.2], ["decay", 2.5], ["sustain", 0], ["noise", 0.25], ["gain", 0.7]] })

hooks.def("grit", { params: { amt: { min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 } }, chain: [["shape", { $param: "amt" }]] })

// == glyphcore/phonk v2: atoms (a no* gate is where a group is off) ==
atom("ph2.slides", { type: "mini", body: "<[0 -5 0] [0 -2 0] [0 -3 0] [0 0 7]>" })
atom("ph2.toms", { type: "mini", body: "~ g2 ~ d3 g2 ~ bb2 ~ ~ g2 d3 ~ bb2 g2 ~ d3" })
atom("ph2.rim", { type: "mini", body: "~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ x" })
atom("ph2.stab", { type: "mini", body: "<[~@12 g5 ~ bb5 ~] [~@8 d6 ~ c6 ~ a5 ~ g5 ~] [~@12 f5 ~ g5 ~] [~@8 bb5 ~ a5 ~ g5 ~ d5 ~]>" })
atom("ph2.stut", { type: "mini", body: "<~!3 [~@8 x x x x [x x] [x x] [x x x] [x x x]]>" })
atom("ph2.rise", { type: "mini", body: "<~ ~ ~ x>/4" })
atom("ph2.heart", { type: "mini", body: "x ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~" })
atom("ph2.noDrums", { type: "gate", body: "<9b, 33b..41b, 53b..61b, 81b.." })
atom("ph2.noKick", { type: "gate", body: "<17b, 33b..41b, 53b..65b, 81b.." })
atom("ph2.noSub", { type: "gate", body: "<5b, 9b..17b, 33b..41b, 53b..65b, 81b.., 17b..17.3b, 41b..41.3b, 65b..65.3b" })
atom("ph2.noConf", { type: "gate", body: "<17b, 33b..65b, 81b.." })
atom("ph2.noRelief", { type: "gate", body: "<33b, 41b..53b, 61b.." })
atom("ph2.dropB", { type: "gate", body: "41b..53b" })
atom("ph2.vac", { type: "gate", body: "16.3b..17b, 40.3b..41b, 64.3b..65b" })
atom("ph2.noRoll", { type: "gate", body: "<15b, 17b..63b, 65b.." })
atom("ph2.noRise", { type: "gate", body: "<13b, 17b..61b, 65b.." })
atom("ph2.noRev", { type: "gate", body: "<16b, 17b..40b, 41b..64b, 65b.." })
atom("ph2.noHit", { type: "gate", body: "<17b, 18b..41b, 42b..65b, 66b.." })
atom("ph2.drops", { type: "gate", body: "17b..33b, 41b..53b, 65b..81b" })
atom("ph2.conf", { type: "gate", body: "17b..33b, 65b..81b" })
atom("ph2.reliefs", { type: "gate", body: "33b..41b, 53b..61b" })
atom("ph2.relief2", { type: "gate", body: "53b..61b" })
atom("ph2.dark", { type: "gate", body: "<9b, 33b..41b" })
atom("ph2.slams", { type: "gate", body: "24.3b..25b, 28.3b..29b, 72.3b..73b, 76.3b..77b" })
atom("ph2.builds", { type: "gate", body: "9b..17b, 61b..65b" })

// == glyphcore/phonk v2: racks ==
hooks.def("pumpHard", { params: { depth: { min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.8 } }, chain: [["duckorbit", { $mini: "3:4:5:6:7:8" }], ["duckdepth", { $param: "depth" }], ["duckattack", 0.23]] })
hooks.def("tom", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-perc"], ["s", "sine"], ["penv", 7], ["pdecay", 0.05], ["decay", 0.16], ["sustain", 0], ["noise", 0.2], ["shape", 0.3], ["gain", 0.85]] })
hooks.def("rimshot", { chain: [["hook", "hygiene-perc"], ["s", "square"], ["note", "a4"], ["noise", 0.6], ["bpf", 1400], ["decay", 0.05], ["sustain", 0], ["gain", 0.6]] })
hooks.def("slam", { chain: [["lpf", 320]] })
hooks.def("open", { chain: [["lpf", 4200], ["room", 0.5]] })
hooks.def("swellPad", { chain: [["attack", 1.8], ["release", 3], ["gain", 0.4]] })
hooks.def("hush", { chain: [["postgain", 0.5]] })

// == track: racks into slots, gated moves ==
hooks.bind("kick", "kick808"); hooks.bind("snare", "snareNoise"); hooks.bind("hat", "hat"); hooks.bind("bell", "cowbell"); hooks.bind("sub", "sub808")
hooks.bind("pad", "hazePad"); hooks.bind("ctr", "echoPluck"); hooks.bind("rise", "riser"); hooks.bind("rev", "reverseHit"); hooks.bind("hit", "impact")
hooks.bind("vox", "chop"); hooks.bind("voxpad", "formant"); hooks.bind("tex", "tape"); hooks.bind("tom", "tom"); hooks.bind("rim", "rimshot")
hooks.bind("lead", "deepLead"); hooks.bind("groove", [["swingBy", 0.16, 4]], atoms.ph2.dropB); hooks.bind("kfeel", [["struct", { $mini: "x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~" }]], atoms.ph2.dropB)
hooks.bind("tone", "murk", atoms.ph2.dark); hooks.bind("tone", "thin", atoms.ph2.builds); hooks.bind("tone", "slam", atoms.ph2.slams)
hooks.bind("drive", "grit(0.7)", atoms.ph2.drops); hooks.bind("tone", "hush", atoms.ph2.reliefs); hooks.bind("pump", "pumpHard(0.8)", atoms.ph2.drops)
hooks.bind("voxpad", "swellPad", atoms.ph2.relief2); hooks.bind("tone", "open", atoms.ph2.relief2)

// == macros ==
ctl("macro", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 1 }); ctl("space", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 })
ctl("grit", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 }); ctl("energy", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 })
hooks.map("macro", "lpf", { range: [0.1, 1], curve: "exp", op: "mul" }); hooks.map("space", "room", { range: [0, 2], op: "mul" })
hooks.map("space", "room", { range: [0, 3.2], op: "mul" }, atoms.ph2.reliefs)
hooks.map("grit", "shape", { range: [0, 2], op: "mul" }); hooks.map("energy", "velocity", { range: [0.6, 1.4], op: "mul" })

// == lanes ==
kick: s(atoms.ph.kick).use("kfeel").use("kick").use("pump").velocity(1).tags("drums", "low")
heart: s(atoms.ph2.heart).use("kick").velocity(0.35).lpf(300).tags("relief")
snare: s(atoms.ph.snare).use("snare").velocity(1).room(0.25).tags("drums")
ghost: s(atoms.ph.ghost).use("snare").velocity(0.22).tags("drums")
stut: s(atoms.ph2.stut).use("snare").velocity(saw.range(0.4, 1)).tags("conf")
roll: s(atoms.ph.roll).use("snare").velocity(saw.range(0.25, 1).slow(2)).tags("roll")
hats: s(atoms.ph.hats).use("hat").velocity(atoms.ph.accent).nudge(rand.range(0, 0.006)).swingBy(0.06, 8).use("groove").postgain(0.6).tags("drums")
perc: stack(note(atoms.ph2.toms).use("tom"), s(atoms.ph2.rim).use("rim")).tags("conf")
bell: note(atoms.ph.bell).add(note("0,6.8")).use("bell").orbit(7).tags("conf", "wet")
stab: note(atoms.ph2.stab).add(note("0,6.8")).use("bell").velocity(1.1).orbit(7).tags("conf", "wet")
chime: note(atoms.ph.bell).slow(2).add(note("0,6.8")).use("bell").velocity(0.35).lpf(2500).orbit(7).tags("relief", "wet")
sub: note(atoms.ph.sub).penv(atoms.ph2.slides).use("sub").postgain(1).use("drive").orbit(3).tags("bass")
pad: note(atoms.ph.chords).use("pad").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(900, 1800)).use("tone").pan(0.5).orbit(4).tags("harm", "wet")
lead: note(atoms.ph.lead).use("lead").use("tone").use("drive").room(0.3).orbit(5).tags("melody", "wet")
ctr: note(atoms.ph.counter).use("ctr").use("tone").orbit(6).tags("conf", "wet")
voxpad: s("<vs_o_pp vs_a_pp>/2").note("<g4 d4>/2").use("voxpad").use("tone").orbit(4).tags("vox", "wet")
vox: stack(word("<ay ee>").struct(atoms.ph.ghost).use("vox").end(0.12).tags("conf"),
  word("air").struct(atoms.ph.lastBar).attack(0.45).release(0.05).speed(0.8).hpf(500).gain(0.3),
  word("breath").note("d#4").struct("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ x]>").gain(0.25)).tags("vox", "wet")
rise: s(atoms.ph2.rise).use("rise").tags("rise")
rev: s(atoms.ph.lastBar).use("rev").tags("rev", "pre")
hit: s("x").use("hit").room(0.4).tags("hit")
tex: stack(s("pink, brown").use("tex"), s("white*8").degradeBy(0.6).attack(0.002).decay(0.015).sustain(0).hpf(2500).gain(rand.range(0.02, 0.07))).tags("tex")
verb: ret("verb").room(1).rsize(5).hpf(200).lpf(5000).orbit(8)
glue: ret("glue").compressor("-24:4:6:.01:.15").gain(0.5).orbit(9)

// == arrangement and mix: selections, not copies ==
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.ph2.noDrums); tagged("low").mute(atoms.ph2.noKick); tagged("#sub").mute(atoms.ph2.noSub)
tagged("conf").mute(atoms.ph2.noConf); tagged("relief").mute(atoms.ph2.noRelief); tagged("#pad | #ctr").mute(atoms.ph2.dropB)
tagged("roll").mute(atoms.ph2.noRoll); tagged("rise").mute(atoms.ph2.noRise); tagged("rev").mute(atoms.ph2.noRev); tagged("hit").mute(atoms.ph2.noHit)
tagged("!pre").mute(atoms.ph2.vac)
tagged("wet").send("verb", 0.35); tagged("low | bass").send("glue", 0.35)
